February 8th., 32.

My dear Steptoe,

Further to my letter of December 22,
I send you herewith a copy of a report * made by
a detective of the Special Branch on the subject
of one Chen Han Seng (陳漢生) and one Wan
Liang Tsung (萬良準).

Yours sincerely,

pages.en:
The following information has been obtained
establishing the identity of Chen Han Seng (陈翰笙 ),
the holder of P.O. Box No.422 and Wan Liang Tsung
(萬良箏) of the Social Science Research Department
of the National Central Research Institute.
(1) Chen Han Seng (陈翰笙 ), age about 30, native
of Wusish has been residing at No.230 Route Prosper
Paris for the past two years. He is employed with the
Editorial Department of the Commercial Press Ltd. He
is said to be of a respectable character and receives
very few visitors.
(2) Wan Liang Tsung (萬良箏), Social Science Research
Department of the National Central Research Institute.
Wan Liang Tsung, age about 30, native Of Kiangsi,
was formerly in the employ of the Social Science Research
Department of the National Central Research Institute,
Nos.2/4 Route Comille Loriox, in charge of the general
affairs department for a period of six months. He left
Shanghai for his native place towards the end of November
1931. Although nothing is known in this office against
this individual, it is learned that certain students of
the National Central Research Institute harbour pro-
communist tendencies.

Officer i/c Special Branch
pages.zh:
已获取以下信息，以确认邮政信箱422号持有人陈翰笙（Chen Han Seng）以及国立中央研究院社会科学研究所万良筝（Wan Liang Tsung）的身份。
(1) 陈翰笙（Chen Han Seng），年龄约30岁，无锡籍，过去两年一直居住在巴黎路（Route Prosper Paris）230号。他就职于商务印书馆有限公司编辑部。据说其品行端正，访客极少。
(2) 万良筝（Wan Liang Tsung），国立中央研究院社会科学研究所。
万良筝，年龄约30岁，江西籍，此前受雇于科米尔·洛里奥路（Route Comille Loriox）2/4号的国立中央研究院社会科学研究所，负责总务部工作，为期六个月。他于1931年11月底离开上海返回原籍。虽然本处室对该人并无不良记录，但获悉国立中央研究院的某些学生怀有亲共倾向。

特别处主管警官

With reference to the endorsement of the Officer
i/c Special Branch on the attached report instructing that
discreet enquiries be made with a view to locating and
establishing the identity of Chen Han Seng (陳漢生), the
holder of P.O. Box No. 1422 and Wan Liang Tsung (萬良準) of
the Social Science Research Department of the National Central
Research Institute, the following information has been obtained:-
(1) Chen Han Seng (陳漢生), age about 30, native of Wusieh,
has been residing at No. 230 Route Prosper Paris for the past
two years. He is employed with the Editorial Department of
the Commercial Press Ltd. He is said to be of a respectable
character and receives very few visitors.
(2) Wan Liang Tsung (萬良準), Social Science Research
Department of the National Central Research Institute.

Wan Liang Tsung, age about 30, native of Kiangsi,
was formerly in the employ of the Social Science Research Depart-
ment of the National Central Research Institute, Nos. 2/4 Route
Comille Loriot, in charge of the general affairs department for
a period of six months. He left Shanghai for his native place
towards the end of November 1931. Although nothing is known in
this office against this individual, it is learned that certain
students of the National Central Research Institute harbour
pro-communist tendencies.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
